content_sections.heading: ISRO IPRC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Not specified in the official notification: This short notice does not detail a written examination pattern, syllabus, or overall selection stages for Technical Assistant or Technician ‘B’ posts. Only the following post-specific requirements are mentioned: Cook ‘A’: Candidates must produce their experience/skill certificate (issued by a well-established Hotel/Canteen) during a Skill Test; certificates from individuals will not be accepted. Fireman ‘A’: Candidates must satisfy prescribed Physical Fitness Standards and must upload a Preliminary Medical Examination Certificate along with the online application.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ISRO IPRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Important: The portal will be open for applying only from 15.09.2026 to 05.10.2026. Application fee details are Not specified in the official notification as reviewed.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: SSLC/SSC/Matric (10th Standard) certificate and mark sheet Relevant Diploma certificate (First Class), for Technical Assistant posts ITI certificate with NTC (National Trade Certificate) from NCVT, or NAC (National Apprenticeship Certificate) from NCVT, in the relevant trade, for Technician ‘B’ posts Experience/skill certificate from a well-established Hotel/Canteen (institutional certificate only, not from an individual), for Cook ‘A’ Preliminary Medical Examination Certificate, for Fireman ‘A’ (to be uploaded with the online application) Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), where applicable Disability certificate, for candidates applying against the PwBD (OH)-reserved vacancy under Machinist Discharge/Service Certificate, for candidates applying against Ex-Servicemen-reserved vacancies under Fitter and Fireman ‘A’

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Out of the 4 Fitter vacancies, 1 is reserved for Ex-Servicemen. Out of the 3 Machinist vacancies, 1 is reserved for PwBD (Orthopaedically Handicapped – OH). Out of the 3 Fireman ‘A’ vacancies, 1 is reserved for Ex-Servicemen. Cook ‘A’ applicants’ experience certificates must be issued by a well-established Hotel/Canteen; certificates from individuals will not be accepted. Fireman ‘A’ applicants must satisfy prescribed Physical Fitness Standards and upload a Preliminary Medical Examination Certificate with the online application. Interested candidates should visit iprc.gov.in for detailed information, guidelines and applying; the portal is open for applications only from 15.09.2026 to 05.10.2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has ISRO IPRC advertised in 2026?
faq.answer: ISRO Propulsion Complex has advertised 22 posts across 9 post codes – Technical Assistant, Technician ‘B’ (6 trades), Cook ‘A’ and Fireman ‘A’ – vide Advertisement No. IPRC/RMT/2026/01 dated 12.09.2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application portal is open from 15 September 2026 to 5 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Technician ‘B’ posts?
faq.answer: A pass in SSLC/SSC/Matric (10th Standard) along with an ITI certificate (NTC or NAC from NCVT) in the relevant trade – Turner, Fitter, Welder, Machinist, Refrigeration & AC, or Electrician.

faq.question: Q4. What is required for the Cook ‘A’ post?
faq.answer: A pass in SSLC/SSC/Matric plus 5 years’ experience as a Cook in a well-established Hotel/Canteen, with an institutional experience/skill certificate produced during the Skill Test.

faq.question: Q5. What is required for the Fireman ‘A’ post?
faq.answer: A pass in SSLC/SSC/Matric, meeting the prescribed Physical Fitness Standards, and uploading a Preliminary Medical Examination Certificate with the online application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for these posts?
faq.answer: Technical Assistant is at Level 7 (Rs.44,900–Rs.1,42,400); Technician ‘B’ is at Level 3 (Rs.21,700–Rs.69,100); Cook ‘A’ and Fireman ‘A’ are at Level 2 (Rs.19,900–Rs.63,200).

faq.question: Q7. Where can I apply for ISRO IPRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only through iprc.gov.in.
